exercises.title: A k-way merge
exercises.task: Each thread's trace is sorted by time. Write MergeAll: one timeline of every event, in O(N log k) for N events from k threads, with a heap holding the next event of each thread. The spec is in the file.
hints: The heap holds one cursor per thread that still has events: (thread, index of its next event). The top is the cursor whose event has the smallest time; on a tie, the smaller thread number.
Loop: pop the top cursor, append its event, and if that thread has more events, push the cursor again with index+1 (or change it in place and call heap.Fix(h, 0)).
Two threads is the merge of 1.5.2; the heap only answers "which of the k heads is smallest?" in O(log k) instead of comparing all k.
